messages:
maya (docs): Heads up — I'm prepping a compact errref update to unify 429 / timeouts / context-limit fallback examples. Need owners for SDK snippet checks and one-liner rollback guidance.

arjun (eng-runtime): +1. Can we include the Retry-After guidance and the new X-Runtime-Variant header? Also note runtime now surfaces KV prefix cache hints for partial-stream resumes — worth a note.

kelly (sdk): I can check the Python + Node snippets. Need exact HTTP examples (curl) and expected headers. Prefer a tiny SDK pattern showing status handling.

maya (docs): I'll draft the curl examples and the short migration blurb. For SDK snippets: show how to use ctx.timeout / retry headers and a tiny backoff.

sam (qa): Add a smoketest checklist pls — synthetic 429 repro steps, expected logs, and how to assert fallback happened. I can write the harness once snippets are merged.

arjun (eng-runtime): Implementation detail: when we do a graceful fallback to a cheaper variant we set X-Runtime-Variant and X-Fallback-Reason. Also include Retry-After when it's deliberate throttling. Recommend doc shows reading those headers.

kelly (sdk): ack. I'll add parsing example. Draft snippet: 
```python
resp = client.generate(payload)
if resp.status_code == 429:
    retry = resp.headers.get('Retry-After')
    variant = resp.headers.get('X-Runtime-Variant')
    # small backoff, then try fallback variant if present
```
Will also add Node equivalent. :thumbsup:

maya (docs): Nice. One more ask — several internal anchors under /errref moved (context-limits -> context-window). I'll sweep links in the migration guide; call out the old->new anchors so eng docs redirects can be added.

deploy-bot: docs-ci build queued — 3 files changed, 2 warnings.

sam (qa): QA will run the replay harness against the synthetic-429 scenario post-merge. Please tag me on the PR so I can pick up the run.

maya (docs): I'll open a single PR that contains: compact errref page (examples + header table), curl examples, python/node snippets, and a tiny migration note with anchor map. CC @kelly @arjun. Aiming to open in ~3 hours.

kelly (sdk): Cool — will review the snippets once PR is up. If we need to tweak SDK surface for X-Runtime-Variant, I'll file a follow-up.

arjun (eng-runtime): If PR includes the header names and example behavior, infra can add the redirect rules in the same release window.

maya (docs): Thanks all. Action items: maya -> draft PR; kelly -> snippet review; sam -> QA harness; arjun -> confirm header names in prod. Back in a few hours. :sparkles:
